verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents official OpenFeature providers that can be used in an application in place of a LaunchDarkly SDK, which directly addresses vendor-neutral flag code. However, the docs say providers exist only for "several" SDKs, and the pack never lists which languages are covered or how fully they match native SDK features. Missing for 10: enumeration of which SDKs/languages have OpenFeature providers, evidence of feature parity with native SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the providers in use.
